ShaderNodePreset.Description: Edge-tangent advection. Smear mode warps along edges; Flow (LIC) mode accumulates fibrous brushstroke-like streaks.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: Advection

Uniform.Tooltip: Step size in pixels per iteration.
Uniform.Name: strength

Uniform.Tooltip: Steps per direction. Flow mode walks this many steps forward AND backward (2x total samples).
Uniform.Name: iterations

Uniform.Tooltip: Minimum gradient magnitude to trigger advection. Raise to restrict effect to stronger edges only.
Uniform.Name: edge_threshold

Uniform.Tooltip: Off = Smear (sample at walk endpoint — warp/distortion). On = Flow/LIC (accumulate along path — fibrous brushstroke streaks).
Uniform.Name: mode

Uniform.Tooltip: Rotates the walk direction by this many degrees. 0 = along edge tangent. 90 = perpendicular to edge (gradient direction). Mix for diagonal flows.
Uniform.Name: flow_bias

Uniform.Tooltip: Amplitude of wave rotation applied to the walk direction (radians). 0 = no wave.
Uniform.Name: wave_amp

Uniform.Tooltip: Off = linear wave phase along X. On = radial wave phase from Center point.
Uniform.Name: radial_waves

Uniform.Tooltip: Centre point for radial waves, in UV coordinates (0-1).
Uniform.Name: center
